name: POST /api/voice-agent/test-sessions - Talk to an agent version from the browser
description: Opens a browser test session against any version of the tenant's agent — drafts included, no phone number (381767f5-a64c-4c63-9918-9feab02424ec#AC1 — a user can open a browser test session against a draft agent version and talk to it). Body: agent_id (uuid), optional version_id (uuid; default = the latest version), ttl_s (60-3600, default 900). Creates a call record flagged is_test=true (direction inbound) and returns a LiveKit participant token for room va-test-<call_id> on the platform LiveKit (livekit_url); the token dispatches the voice-runtime agent with the tenant, call and version to run. is_test calls are never metered as billable minutes and never mirrored onto a subject's conversation thread or CRM timeline (381767f5-a64c-4c63-9918-9feab02424ec#AC2 — test sessions are never metered as billable minutes). The version's stack profile must be active; 503 VoiceRuntimeUnavailable when LiveKit is not configured (LIVEKIT_URL / LIVEKIT_API_KEY / LIVEKIT_API_SECRET).

testCases.name: Open a test session on the draft version

errorCases.message: agent_id must be a uuid | version_id must be a uuid | ttl_s must be an integer between 60 and 3600
agent not found | agent version not found
errorCases.when: agent or version is not this tenant's

errorCases.message: agent is archived | agent has no versions to test | the version's stack profile is not active
voice media (LiveKit) is not configured on this deployment
